question: to the Commission Lynn Boylan (The Left), Özlem Demirel (The Left), Kathleen Funchion (The Left), Danilo Della Valle (The Left) Subject:

Article 7 of Regulation (EU) 2025/11061 (SAFE Regulation) requires Member States who wish to avail of loans under the Security Action for Europe (SAFE)2 instrument to submit a defence industry investment plan. Article 7(2) requires that such a plan includes a description of the defence product and of the other products for defence purposes and a description of the planned activities, estimated expenditures and measures. Serious concerns have been raised in respect of the ability of Member States to use SAFE loans to procure cluster munitions or anti-personnel mines in violation of the Convention on Cluster Munitions3 and the Anti-Personnel Mine Ban Convention4. These concerns are compounded by the fact that a number of Member States who have left either or both conventions have already received substantial funding under SAFE. Can the Commission confirm: 1.
whether any defence industry investment plans submitted under Article 7 have specified that loans will be used to procure cluster munitions or anti-personnel mines;
whether Member States are advised against using loans to procure such weapons;
whether Member States who are party to either or both conventions are advised of their financial liabilities should a Member State who procures such weapons fail to repay the loan?

Council Regulation (EU) 2025/1106 of 27 May 2025 establishing the Security Action for Europe (SAFE) through the Reinforcement of the European Defence Industry Instrument (OJ L, 2025/1106, 28.5.2025, ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/reg/2025/1106/oj). 2 SAFE, https://defence-industry-space.ec.europa.eu/eu-defence-industry/safe-security-action-europe_en. 3 The Convention on Cluster Munitions, https://www.clusterconvention.org/convention-text/. 4 Convention on the Prohibition of the Use, Stockpiling, Production and Transfer of Anti-Personnel Mines and on Their Destruction, https://www.apminebanconvention.org/en/convention-text. 1
